**Finding: compliant (at fallback)** — § 15.16 Nonsolicitation (p0841).

The clause meets our fallback on every material term:
- **Mutual** — "neither Party shall solicit," so SFJ is equally bound.
- **Narrow scope** — limited to employees "who is or has been involved in the performance or oversight of any of the development activities hereunder," not all personnel.
- **Solicitation only, no no-hire** — it bars soliciting someone to terminate employment; there is no prohibition on hiring or engaging. A regex sweep for "employ or engage" / "no-hire" / "induce" found no other restrictive covenant in the document.
- **General-advertising carve-out** — express right to make generalized searches via trade journal, newspaper or website.

Noted but not redlined (minor sub-elements): the tail duration is redacted ("[***] thereafter"), so 12 months cannot be confirmed, and there is no standalone unsolicited-approach carve-out — largely achieved anyway by the solicitation-only framing. Worth confirming the redacted tail on the commercial side; anything beyond 24 months would be walk-away territory and should be revisited.
